CWE-186.original_description: A regular expression is overly restrictive, which prevents dangerous values from being detected.
CWE-186.description: A regular expression is overly restrictive, which prevents dangerous values from being detected. This weakness is not about regular expression complexity. Rather, it is about a regular expression that does not match all values that are intended. Consider the use of a regexp to identify acceptable values or to spot unwanted terms.
